scripts.lint: bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts packages tests bench
scripts.lint:fix: bun --bun oxlint -c oxlint.config.ts --fix packages tests bench
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/engine packages/cli tests
scripts.test:headless: bun run lint && bun test packages/core packages/engine packages/cli tests/architecture tests/quality
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test packages/core packages/engine packages/cli tests/architecture tests/quality
